# Smile Time Kids

> > Smile Time Kids is a pediatric dental practice in Richmond, IN offering comprehensive preventive, restorative, and emergency dental care for children with a team of specialized pediatric dentists.

Smile Time Kids provides family-friendly pediatric dental services in Richmond, Indiana, with a focus on cavity prevention, restorative care, and specialized treatments like frenectomies and dental sedation. The practice is staffed by board-certified pediatric dentists including Dr. Jennifer Crist, Dr. Michelle H. Edwards, and Dr. Rebecca Rafla.

## Preventative & Restorative Services

- [Pediatric Preventative Dental Cleanings](https://www.smiletimekids.com/preventative-cleaning): Preventive dental cleanings for cavity prevention and oral health
- [Pediatric Dental Sealants](https://www.smiletimekids.com/dental-sealants): Protective dental sealants to prevent cavities in children's teeth
- [Pediatric Fluoride Treatments](https://www.smiletimekids.com/fluoride-treatments): Fluoride treatments to strengthen enamel and prevent tooth decay
- [Pediatric Dental Fillings & Crowns](https://www.smiletimekids.com/dental-fillings-crowns): Restorative dental fillings and crowns for children at Smile Time Kids

## Specialized Treatments & Emergency Care

- [Pediatric Dental Emergencies](https://www.smiletimekids.com/dental-emergencies): Emergency dental care services for children in Richmond, IN
- [Pediatric Dental Sedation & Anesthesia](https://www.smiletimekids.com/dental-sedation-and-anesthesia): Safe sedation and anesthesia options for anxious pediatric patients
- [Pediatric Frenectomy](https://www.smiletimekids.com/frenectomy): Frenectomy procedure to treat tongue-ties and lip-ties in children
- [Pediatric Mouth Guards](https://www.smiletimekids.com/mouth-guards): Custom mouth guards for sports protection and bruxism in children
- [Teledentistry](https://www.smiletimekids.com/teledentistry): Virtual dental consultations and remote care services for children

- [Choosing the Right Toothpaste](https://www.smiletimekids.com/choosing-the-right-toothpaste): Guide to selecting appropriate toothpaste for children's oral care
- [Flossing For Kids](https://www.smiletimekids.com/flossing-for-kids): Guide to teaching children proper flossing techniques and habits
- [Composite Resin vs Amalgam Fillings](https://www.smiletimekids.com/composite-resin-vs-amalgam-fillings): Comparison of filling materials for children's dental restorations
